name: Nordic Country
description: Born in a Nordic welfare state. Universal healthcare, excellent education, social safety nets. Congratulations, you won the lottery.

name: Western Europe
description: Born in Western Europe. Strong healthcare, education systems. Life is generally stable.

name: Japan/South Korea
description: Born in East Asian developed nation. High life expectancy, intense education culture.

name: North America - Middle Class
description: Born in urban/suburban North America to middle-class family. Access to healthcare varies.

name: Eastern Europe
description: Born in Eastern Europe. Post-Soviet transition, mixed economy, decent healthcare.

name: Urban China
description: Born in a Chinese city. Rapid development, good infrastructure, intense competition.

name: Urban Latin America
description: Born in a Latin American city. Stark inequality, decent urban services, violence varies.

name: Southeast Asia
description: Born in Southeast Asia. Rapid growth, improving healthcare, vulnerability to climate.

name: Urban South Asia
description: Born in a South Asian city. Dense population, pollution, healthcare access varies wildly.

name: Rural South Asia
description: Born in a rural South Asian village. Agriculture-based, limited healthcare, strong community bonds.

name: Rural Sub-Saharan Africa
description: Born in a rural African village. Subsistence farming, limited healthcare, but community is everything.

name: Urban Sub-Saharan Africa
description: Born in an African city. Rapid urbanization, slums alongside development, hustle culture.

name: Middle East - Stable
description: Born in a stable Middle Eastern country. Variable by oil wealth and governance.

name: Active War Zone
description: Born during active armed conflict. Survival is uncertain, infrastructure collapsed.

name: Fragile/Post-Conflict State
description: Born in a fragile state recovering from conflict. Violence lingers, rebuilding slowly.
